observed_source.intervention_site: model.model.norm forward-hook output at final token
observed_source.target_vector_construction: normalize(W_A - 0.5*(W_B + W_C)) using model output-embedding / LM-head weights

derivation: Let d = W_A - 0.5*(W_B + W_C), and let v = d / ||d||.
The executor adds g*v to the final normalized hidden state h immediately before the LM head.
For target score S(h)=logit_A - 0.5*(logit_B+logit_C), and a linear LM head with token rows W_i, S(h+g*v)-S(h)=g*d dot v = g*||d||.
Therefore +VECTOR and SIGN_FLIP are expected to shift the selected A-vs-B/C score monotonically by construction, largely independent of the prompt's upstream computation.

This is legitimate evidence that a bound vector was consumed and that readout-adjacent hidden-state control works. It is not by itself evidence that a distributed/global J-Space representation was discovered or causally used by the model's earlier computation.
material_finding.goodhart_risk: If owner-trigger completion is interpreted as Global-J-Space causal evidence rather than the narrower direct-vector-control milestone, this setup can satisfy the observable directional-effect gate through LM-head geometry alone.

counterhypothesis.claim: The readout-adjacent experiment is still useful because Trigger-1 first needs to prove exact reproducible vector consumption and API-bound control before asking where a semantic representation lives.
counterhypothesis.assessment: SUPPORTED_AS_A_COMPONENT_MILESTONE_ONLY. The experiment should be retained as a positive instrumentation/control baseline, but its success must not close the stronger Global-J-Space causal question.

external_research.source: Turner et al., Steering Language Models With Activation Engineering, arXiv:2308.10248
external_research.relevance: Activation Addition derives steering vectors from intermediate activations and injects them during the forward pass to steer high-level behavior.

external_research.source: Zou et al., Representation Engineering: A Top-Down Approach to AI Transparency, arXiv:2310.01405
external_research.relevance: RepE treats population-level internal representations as the object of monitoring and manipulation, motivating representation-derived rather than readout-constructed vectors for stronger semantic claims.

external_research.source: Panickssery et al., Steering Llama 2 via Contrastive Activation Addition, arXiv:2312.06681
external_research.relevance: CAA derives steering directions from residual-stream activation differences and evaluates behavioral effects, providing a stronger template for a non-readout-adjacent Trigger-1 discriminator.

external_research.source: AtP*: An efficient and scalable method for localizing LLM behaviour to components, arXiv:2403.00745
external_research.relevance: Causal localization requires interventions on internal computational nodes and measurement of downstream effects; readout-adjacent changes alone do not localize an upstream causal mechanism.

highest_information_next_discriminator.name: INTERMEDIATE_LAYER_REPRESENTATION_DERIVED_VECTOR_WITH_READOUT_ALGEBRAIC_POSITIVE_CONTROL
requirements: Keep the current final-norm LM-head-derived vector as an explicit READOUT_ALGEBRAIC_POSITIVE_CONTROL rather than deleting it.
Derive a second vector from contrastive Qwen3-0.6B residual-stream activations on calibration-only prompt pairs; do not use LM-head token rows to construct that vector.
Select layer and gain using calibration only; freeze them before holdout.
Apply the representation-derived vector at one or more intermediate residual-stream sites with the same BASELINE/+VECTOR/SIGN_FLIP/NULL/ORTHOGONAL/PERMUTED controls.
Use disjoint holdout prompt families and fixed seeds; include off-target tasks so a token-specific readout hack cannot masquerade as semantic steering.
Add a layer-shuffle or wrong-layer control and a rescue test: lesion/remove the representation-derived direction and restore it at the preregistered layer.
Report both target-logit effect and behavior-level transfer. Require the representation-derived effect to survive beyond the readout-algebraic baseline's narrow A/B/C target metric.
Bind exact source tree, dirty state, Python/Torch/Transformers, checkpoint/tokenizer, vector source packets, layer, gain, API endpoint and every runtime receipt.
highest_information_next_discriminator.falsifier: If the representation-derived intermediate-layer vector fails to reproduce a directional holdout effect while the readout-algebraic control succeeds, retain direct vector-consumption credit but reject the stronger Global-J-Space representation hypothesis for that vector/task.
highest_information_next_discriminator.promotion_rule: No Global-J-Space/model credit from final-norm LM-head-derived steering alone, even if all six matched controls and disjoint holdout pass.
